title: Resume a retained export candidate through a verified amendment

rubric.text: Consumes the supported planner-owned effective contract only after fresh source/chain/trusted-readback/review/approval and retained-candidate checks; does not define or publish a competing amendment format

Preserves O1, W1, branch/PR 42, completed increments, dirty edit and two consumed attempts; permits only authorised integration from verified C1 while the resulting SHA is pending, never readiness on a pending result

Invalidates export/validator/privacy/inventory evidence for D2/R2 and changed fixture/filters, renews uncertain impact and all mandatory integrated checks; retains only demonstrably unaffected documentation evidence with original provenance and compatibility rationale

Carries original requirements, effective contract, old/new base and candidate identities, validation provenance, F7 repair/disposition and prior coverage into review; covers integration range and interactions under each affected contract and widens when unbounded
Binds actual integration result commit/tree and base plus renewed checks/review to A1 and the effective contract, distinguishing prior from outstanding coverage in the controller handoff
Leaves claim/lease revalidation and scheduling to the controller, preserves native blockers/qualification/bounded grants, and neither restarts the lifecycle gratuitously nor expands authority

Stops dependent work and preserves artifacts on unexplained C9 pending reconciliation; for an unsupported planner retains the existing reviewed full-replan path or reports an amendment-only request blocked without inventing support
Makes no mutation, execution claim, ready/merge claim or blanket retry in this analysis-only state
